standard-dialogue.npc: Good day, how may I help you?

steps.npc: This is the great Castle Wars arena! Here you can fight for the glory of Saradomin or Zamorak.

options.text: Really, how do I do that?

steps.player: Really, how do I do that?

steps.npc: Easy, you just step through one of the three portals. To join Zamorak, pass through the red portal. To join Saradomin, pass through the blue portal. If you don't mind then pass through the green portal.

Of course, there are always rules. Firstly you can't wear a cape as you enter the portal, you'll be given your team colours to wear while in the arena. You're also prohibited from taking non-combat related items in with you. So you should only have equipment, potions, and runes on you. Secondly, attacking your own team or your team's defences isn't allowed. You don't want to be angering your patron god, do you? Other than that, just have fun and enjoy it!

steps.player: Great! Oh, how do I win the game?

steps.npc: The aim is to get into your opponents' castle and take their team standard. Then bring that back and capture it on your team's standard.
Players on the winning team will receive 2 Castle Wars Tickets which you can trade back to me for other items. In the event of a draw every player will get 1 ticket.

options.text: Take a look at this dead chicken I've got.
options.condition: If the player has any of Ava's devices in their inventory

steps.player: Take a look at this dead chicken I've got.

steps.text: If the player has not shown the Ava's device to Lanthus before:

steps.npc: ... I'm looking at the dead chicken. Why am I looking at the dead chicken?

steps.player: It's a special device, invented by a friend of mine. If I'm wearing it while ranging, it uses magnets to retrieve some of my ammunition.

steps.npc: Oh. Gosh. That's clever. So are you wanting to take it into Castle Wars? The gods expect people to fight in the team capes.

steps.player: Can they be a bit more flexible, please?

steps.npc: I'll ask. Hold on a minute...
... (Lanthus communes with the gods.)
The gods say they'll protect your ammunition in the same way that the chicken would, while you're fighting in Castle Wars. You won't need to wear the chicken here.

steps.text: If the player has shown a worse Ava's device to Lanthus before:

steps.npc: I remember you! You showed me this dead chicken device before, but this one is better is it!?
Hold on...
... (Lanthus communes with the gods.)
The gods say they'll protect your ammunition in the same way that this better chicken would, while you're fighting in Castle Wars.

steps.text: If the player has shown the Ava's device to Lanthus before:

steps.npc: I remember you. You said your dead chicken could help you save ammunition. The gods agreed that you could have the same bonus in Castle Wars without needing to wear the chicken.
So you don't need to keep showing me the dead chicken, do you? Take it away!

options.text: What do you have for trade?
Do you have a manual? I'd like to learn how to play!

steps.player: Do you have a manual? I'd like to learn how to play!

steps.npc: Sure, here you go.

steps.text: Castlewars manual shows up in inventory.

options.text: Is there something I can do with these bracelets?
options.condition: If the player has a Castle wars bracelet in their inventory

steps.player: Is there something I can do with these bracelets?

steps.npc: Yes, if you're wearing one when you enter a game of Castle Wars, it will use one charge to empower your attacks against flag bearers and give you increased healing from bandages.
Bear in mind that you only need to be wearing it when you enter the game to get the benefit.
If you'd prefer, if you give the bracelet to me, I can grant you the buff instead, but I'll only do it once for each charge you give me.
Just show me the bracelet and I'll take it off your hands.

options.text: How many bracelet charges do I have stored?
options.condition: If the player has stored bracelets with Lanthus

steps.player: How many bracelet charges do I have stored?

steps.npc: Currently, I'm storing [#] charges for you. If you hand me more bracelets, I can store more charges for you.

options.text: Can I stop using my stored bracelet charges?
options.condition: If the player has stored bracelets with Lanthus and has enabled the use of stored charges

steps.player: Can I stop using my stored bracelet charges?

steps.npc: That seems like a strange thing to ask for, but very well, I'll stop using your stored bracelet charges on you. Talk to me if you want to start using them again.

options.text: I'd like to use my stored bracelet charges again.
options.condition: If the player has stored bracelets with Lanthus and has disabled the use of stored charges

steps.player: I'd like to use my stored bracelet charges again.

steps.npc: Ah, that's more like it! Yes, I'll start using your stored bracelet charges on you if you don't have a Castle Wars bracelet equipped when a game starts. Talk to me again if you decide you'd rather not have me do that.
